column1: # fixture: a Go source file beside this one (kept as .go.txt so no Go tool
#          takes it for part of the module).
# placed_at: the repository path the gate judges the fixture as if it were at.
# unbounded: how many unbounded children the gate must report there.
# an interpreter leg's test (covered before the compiled legs were)
# a compiled leg's test: it builds a binary, then runs it
# a run-helper package: every file is judged, not only its tests
# outside the gate's reach: a covered package's non-test file, and a package
